  • EVENT NAME

  • Avoid using ALL CAPS and exclamation marks "!"

  • DATE & TIME

  • If your event takes place on multiple dates, please let us know in the event description field below.
  • If there is no currently scheduled end date leave the "event end date" field blank.
  • Let us know if it's every Monday, every 3rd Tuesday, always the 1st Saturday in December...

    Let us know if this event is online, or takes place at a physical location where people can attend.

  • TICKETS & COST

    Early bird and local-resident (SF or Bay Area) discounts are OK - just tell us about the discount below in "Cost Details". Don't use senior, student, EBT or kids prices.

  • Tip: You'll have a better chance getting your event posted if you write a compelling preview of your event and avoid ALL CAPS, excessive formatting and lots of !!!! exclamation marks.

  • IMAGES & PHOTOS

  • Upload a JPG or GIF image no more than 1MB. Do not submit PNGs or PDFs.
  • Please add the name of the rights holder for the photograph/image. Never use images that you don't have permission from the copyright holder to use.
